title: dev-run/1: one development-run admission in data/evaluation/runs.jsonl
description: Derived from the admission package's campaign-receipt/3 and manifest, plus the operator's provider reconciliation. Spend is an actual-spend upper bound for the admission rule, not an invoice. Holds no local paths, ports or secrets.

study.description: The GitHub issue that owns the study, e.g. 372 or 382.

label.description: The run's short name in its study's dated record (e.g. T1, or the run name).

lineage.description: The manifest's lineage label (e.g. L1), or null for a single-run admission.

ended.description: The receipt's ended_wall as a UTC timestamp.

wall_seconds.description: The receipt's elapsed_seconds, rounded to the second.

spend_usd.description: Decimal string: provider_usd plus unpriced_attempts times unpriced_attempt_usd when those are recorded; otherwise the receipt's configured usage estimate for an admission whose every attempt reported usage.

provider_usd.description: Decimal string of provider-reported cost over the attempts that have a provider record, or null when the split was not recorded.

unpriced_attempts.description: Charged attempts without a provider record, or null when not recorded.

unpriced_attempt_usd.description: Decimal string: the worst-case charge per unpriced attempt, or null when not recorded.
